verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents a Batch Processing API for high-volume processing and an export endpoint that pulls whole record types across a date range, so it has its own bulk capability for screening and data extraction. Depth is unproven: the batch API gets only a one-line mention, and the monitoring endpoints explicitly act on a single customer. Missing for 10: documented batch API semantics and limits, bulk case/alert decisioning or bulk monitor/unmonitor operations, hands-on corroboration of batch execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
